gen-fs-bevellier-gf-martel-sans: Flat, stencil-cut and tightly packed. Bevellier is at its best as a graceful display line with no stroke contrast at all, while Martel Sans does its quiet work in a sans body with generous curve openings.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-matangi: Matangi leads with hefty, twine-like strokes and rounded letters left open, a body that feels contemporary and sturdy. Bevellier's stencil-cut heading sits above it, graceful against that weight.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-maven-pro: Graceful, first of all, with a flat stencil-cut heading. Bevellier's tight sidebearings meet Maven Pro's open gap in the c, and that pull between packed and welcoming is what holds the pair together.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-michroma: Michroma reads wide and spaced out, each letter given room on both sides. Bevellier's tight, constant-width pen line in the heading tucks in close above that sans, so the two feel like opposite ends of one idea.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-miriam-libre: Stencil-cut grace meets wire-drawn weight. Bevellier keeps its letters tightly fitted, and yet Miriam Libre's tall, approachable lowercase gives the pair its strongest quality: a heading that whispers over a body that stands up.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-mochiy-pop-p-one: Approachable is the first impression, thanks to the body's generous gaps between letters. Bevellier packs its heading tight and flat while Mochiy Pop P One spreads out below it in a sizable, brush-free sans.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-montserrat-alternate: Montserrat Alternates brings a wide-open c and lowercase that crowds toward the capital line, giving it a confident, contemporary look. Montserrat Alternates is the roomier half, while Bevellier's stencil-cut, tightly fitted heading supplies the graceful restraint.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-montserrat-underline: Montserrat Underline reads with oversized lowercase and breathing counters, and its round bowls never swell. And Bevellier's flat, stencil-cut heading above it would lead into a long page of that plain sans without any fuss.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-mozilla-headline: Mozilla Headline reads big-bodied and friendly, with a splayed c terminal that gives it character. Mozilla Headline would carry a long passage as a plain sans with confidence, while Bevellier's flat heading stays free of any swelling at the joins.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-mozilla-text: Bevellier draws its graceful, stencil-cut heading with one tube-like track width and very tight sidebearings, a neon-sign flatness. Mozilla Text, a sans-serif with flaring terminals, reads boldly through long paragraphs.
